blocks.text: Proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates aur lipids mukhtalif qisam ke monomers jor kar banaye jate hain. Yeh saare biomolecules apne monomers ko condensation ya dehydration (pani nikalne) ke amal se jorte hain. Condensation mein ek monomer se -OH group aur doosre monomer se -H atom hataya jata hai. Isay dehydration synthesis bhi kehte hain, kyun ke OH aur H ka hatna asal mein pani (H₂O) ke ek molecule ka nikalna hai. Do glucose monomers se maltose ka banna condensation reaction ki misal hai.
Jab monomers se pani nikala jata hai to chemical bonds torne ke liye energy chahiye hoti hai. Is liye macromolecules banane ke liye cells ko energy deni parti hai.

blocks.alt: Glucose + Glucose, har ek ring jis ke dono taraf OH hai; pehle glucose ke daayen OH ka H aur doosre glucose ka baayan OH roshan (highlight) hain. Teer Maltose ki taraf: dono rings ek O ke pul (bridge) se jure, aur neeche pani ka molecule (H-O-H) alag ho raha hai. Labels: Glucose, Glucose, Maltose, Water.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono glucose rings ke kinaron par OH groups hain. Ek glucose ka H aur doosre glucose ka OH (rang se dikhaye gaye) nikal kar mil jate hain aur H₂O (pani) ban jata hai. Bacha hua O dono rings ke darmiyan pul (bridge) ban jata hai; isi tarah maltose banta hai. Pani nikal kar jurna hi dehydration synthesis hai.

Monomers jor kar polymers banane ke saath saath cells polymers torte bhi rehte hain. Hydrolysis woh chemical process hai jis mein pani ke molecules shamil kar ke macromolecule (polymer) ko chhote tukron mein tora jata hai. Yeh dehydration synthesis ka ulat (reverse) hai. Cells monomers ke darmiyan bonds mein pani daal kar unhein torte hain. Is mein pani ke molecule ka OH group ek monomer se jur jata hai aur H doosre monomer se. Pani ka ek molecule shamil kar ke maltose ka do glucose monomers mein tootna hydrolysis ki misal hai.
Macromolecules ka yeh tootna digestion (hazma) aur cellular respiration jaise biological processes mein zaroori hai, jahan energy banane ke liye chhote molecules chahiye hote hain.

blocks.alt: Maltose (do rings ek O ke pul se jure) aur neeche pani ka molecule jis ke teer pul ki taraf hain. Teer Glucose + Glucose ki taraf: pehle par shamil hua H aur doosre par shamil hua OH roshan hain. Labels: Maltose, Water, Glucose, Glucose.

blocks.prompt: Likhein ke jab disaccharide banta hai aur jab toot-ta hai to pani ke molecule ke atoms ka kya hota hai.
blocks.explanation: Banna: ek glucose ka OH aur doosre glucose ka H mil kar pani ka ek molecule ban kar nikal jate hain, aur dono sugars ek oxygen bridge se jur jati hain. Tootna: pani ka molecule toot-ta hai; us ka OH ek glucose se aur H doosre glucose se jurta hai, aur do alag glucose wapas mil jate hain.

items: Condensation (dehydration synthesis): ek monomer se OH aur doosre se H pani ban kar nikalte hain aur monomers jur jate hain; is ke liye energy chahiye. Misal: glucose + glucose → maltose.
Hydrolysis is ka ulat hai: pani shamil hota hai, us ka OH aur H dono monomers ko milte hain aur bond toot jata hai. Misal: maltose → do glucose. Digestion aur respiration is par chalte hain.
